description: Schedule and continue adaptive or Cron loops in the current conversation.

hooks.command: hook="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/goal-guard.mjs"; if [ ! -f "${hook}" ] && [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" ]; then for candidate in "${PLUGIN_ROOT%/*}"/*/scripts/goal-guard.mjs; do [ -f "${candidate}" ] && hook="${candidate}"; done; fi; if [ -f "${hook}" ]; then exec node "${hook}"; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Codex Loop goal guard is unavailable after a plugin update; restart this Codex session before creating a durable goal."}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Keeping Codex Loop and durable goals separate

hooks.command: hook="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session-end.mjs"; if [ ! -f "${hook}" ] && [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" ]; then for candidate in "${PLUGIN_ROOT%/*}"/*/scripts/session-end.mjs; do [ -f "${candidate}" ] && hook="${candidate}"; done; fi; [ -f "${hook}" ] && exec node "${hook}"; exit 0

hook="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/stop-hook.mjs"; if [ ! -f "${hook}" ] && [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" ]; then for candidate in "${PLUGIN_ROOT%/*}"/*/scripts/stop-hook.mjs; do [ -f "${candidate}" ] && hook="${candidate}"; done; fi; if [ -f "${hook}" ]; then exec node "${hook}"; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Codex Loop runtime is unavailable after a plugin update; restart this Codex session before starting or continuing a Loop."}'; fi
